korean_language_program.name: Center for International Education (CIE) — Regular Korean Course
korean_language_program.evidence: CIE's Regular Course is a main program of the CIE designed for foreigners who wish to improve their Korean communication skills ... 10 weeks for 1 semester (200hrs) ... Level 1 to 6 (*Eligible to apply for AJOU University after completing Level 3)

english_taught_degrees.detail: Undergraduate English Track: International Business Major [English Track] and IT Business Major [English Track] (freshman only); Business Administration [English Track] (transfer only), per 2027 Spring guide
english_taught_degrees.evidence: [English Track Major] International Business ... [English Track Major] Business Administration ... Holders of certified English proficiency scores (TOEFL iBT 71, IELTS 5.5, NEW TEPS 326 or above)

support_services.evidence: New Student Orientation & "새내기배움터" ... Providing essential information on academic systems and supporting a stable start through welcoming events for new students

Ajou University provides an 1:1 counseling services for international students enrolled in Ajou University. Counseling is conducted by a professional psychological counselor who can speak English, Chinese, and Korean.
Career Development & Job Camps ... Establishing personalized career roadmaps with experts and operating intensive programs to strengthen practical employment skills
TOPIK (Test of Proficiency in Korean) Preparation Course Eligibility: Undergraduate International students enrolled in Ajou University
